title: POST /api/auth/login — email/password login
description: Implement login with email and password. Verify credentials, issue new access and refresh tokens.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 401 with generic message for invalid credentials (do not reveal which field is wrong)
Returns 200 with { user: { id, email, name }, accessToken } and sets refresh token cookie on success

steps.details: In server/src/validators/auth.ts, add: loginSchema = z.object({ email: z.string().email(), password: z.string().min(1) }).

In server/src/routes/auth.ts, add POST /login: 1) Validate body. 2) Find user by email WHERE deleted_at IS NULL. 3) If not found OR password_hash is null, return 401 'Invalid credentials'. 4) Compare password with bcrypt.compare(password, user.password_hash). If false, return 401. 5) Sign new access + refresh tokens. 6) Delete old refresh tokens for this user (optional: keep last 5 for multi-device). 7) Store new hashed refresh token. 8) Set cookie and return 200 with user and accessToken.
POST /api/auth/login with correct credentials — expect 200 with accessToken. Try wrong password — expect 401. Try non-existent email — expect 401 (same message, not 'user not found').

technicalNotes: Always return the same error message for wrong email vs wrong password — prevents user enumeration
cookie-parser middleware must be installed and applied in index.ts for cookie reading
